category_reasons.prediction_code: Prediction, state inference and submission pipeline code that determines labels.
category_reasons.feature_set: Ball, evidence and possession feature computations used by prediction.
category_reasons.data_transform: Data loading, normalization, model-input conversion and timing configuration.
category_reasons.algorithm_configuration: The frozen state-engine configuration that changes algorithm behavior.
category_reasons.hyperparameters: The frozen numeric parameter values used by the state engine.
category_reasons.evaluation_script: The external evaluation orchestration and result-reporting code.
category_reasons.metric_contract: The metric semantics and metric implementation used to report results.
